emoji.selection: two distinct entries, uniform without replacement; entries from the previous reaction are excluded

interaction.trigger: double tap / double click; Enter / Space for keyboard accessibility
interaction.growthPerAcceptedReaction: one typography step relative to the current device setting
interaction.haptic: native callback; web vibration only if supported
interaction.activeReactionPolicy: each reaction adds six new emoji; earlier emoji keep falling and mix with them (designer original)

integration.stateAuthority: app server; demo uses browser localStorage only
integration.nativeUnits: map motion coordinates to platform logical coordinates; do not copy CSS font sizes
